fix(datasources): server-assign ids for added assignment queries (#7464)

* fix(datasources): server-assign ids for added assignment queries

Members who can't edit the whole data source now get server ids for assignment queries they add. Repeated ids are paired in order, and editing or removing a query is checked against every saved query sharing its id.

* fix(datasources): check every query sharing the id on exposure query updates
